title: Stop Running From the Resistance That Fixes You
description:
You are running from the resistance you avoid because it hurts. Every day you trade the hard set for a scroll, the heavy lift for a notification, and you call it balance while the ledger bleeds. The cost shows up in missed deadlines, weakened posture, and a mind that flinches at discomfort. Stoic logic tells us the obstacle is the path; the friction you dread is the only signal that growth is possible. Choose one avoided task, set a timer for twenty minutes, remove the phone, and execute the first ugly step. Repeat tomorrow, same rule, same timer. The compounding minutes forge a wall the old you cannot climb. No negotiation, no waiting for motivation. Do the work. discipline, stoicism, resistance, action, mindset
